name: Punishment Of Sin
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that sin results in death and punishment, emphasizing personal responsibility for one’s own actions rather than inheriting the guilt of others, as seen in Ezekiel 18:4 and 18:20. The wicked face destruction and everlasting punishment, while those who love God and believe in His Son receive eternal life and preservation (Psalms 145:20; Matthew 25:46; John 3:36). Repentance and conversion are presented as the means by which sins can be forgiven and the believer restored to fellowship with God (Acts 3:19).
